description:
Hand the project to one of its collaborators, as its owner (or a site
    admin, for a project whose owner has gone). They get what only an owner
    has (adding and removing collaborators, handing it on, deleting it) and
    are told, as is the previous owner when a site admin hands it on; you
    stay on as a collaborator, and cannot take it back yourself. Only a collaborator can be given it (``INVALID_INPUT``: add
    them first), and not one who already owns 50 projects
    (``LIMIT_EXCEEDED``). Answers the project.

username.description: The collaborator to make its owner: a username or a user ID.
username.title: Username
